ns2:course.label: Economics of Organizations
ns2:course.description: This course aims to help students to develop a deep understanding of how organizations work from an economic point of view and covers six prominent theories of organizations: (1) Behavioral Theory of the Firm; (2) Transaction Costs Theory; (3) Property Rights Theory; (4) Agency Theory; (5) Dynamic Resource-Based Theory; and (6) Game Theory. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to PHD:Accountancy -UIUC, MS:Business Administrtn -UIUC, MS: Technology Management-UIUC, MS: Accy - Cost Rec -UIUC, or MS:Management -UIUC.
